scope: All monetary model inputs USDm. These paragraphs explain analyst choices; dated issuer facts remain in sources/history.

items.basis: FY2025 corporate rents 10442, royalties 6018, franchisee sales 129675 and conventional franchisee sales 93761 calibrate blended rent and royalty yields. These are observations, not contract rates. Separate comp/unit-sales/FX factors feed three franchise cohorts; only company-operated sales are gross corporate restaurant revenue.
items.editable: All cohort growth arrays, rent_rate_shift, royalty_rate_shift, company revenue growth, restaurant-count illustration
items.uncertainty: Blend can change with market/cohort mix and rent relief. No contractual royalty-by-cohort split is claimed.

items.basis: Q2 global comparable sales 1.3%, H1 2.5%, U.S. guest counts negative; H1 revenues 13616. Base 2026 comp 2%, units weighted about 2.47%, FX1.5%; thereafter stable FX. Net count grows more quickly than first-year sales contribution because opening dates and maturation differ.
items.uncertainty: Illustrative restaurant counts are not a second revenue multiplier.

items.basis: Franchise occupancy expense grows 3% base; company restaurant margin improves from 14.5%2026 to 16.5%2030; SGA declines from 2.2% to 2.0% of systemwide sales. No management target plug. Other technology fees largely recover costs; only the 2025 residual other profit 83 grows 2.5%, rather than assigning franchise margins to all other revenue.
items.editable: occupancy growth, company margin, SGA rate, other profit growth
items.uncertainty: Corporate benefit differs from 250 bp restaurant efficiency; downside has weaker demand, higher costs and 20% support overrun.

items.basis: Base assumes no 2026 spend from newly announced program, 1750 capital+3250 rent relief during 2027–30 and 3500 remaining during 2031–36. Later split 35%capital/65%rent is analyst assumption. September baseline 3000 annual capex supersedes earlier expectation of sequential 2027 capex increases.
items.uncertainty: Annual timing andpost 2030 split were not disclosed; total commitments treated as plan not enforceable debt.2037 finite program ends, but terminal reinvestment persists.

items.basis: Cash-flow D&A2199 in 2025; base 2300 in 2026 grows 3.5%; new finance ROU additions 468 in 2025 support 500 annual economic finance-asset capex assumption, H2 standalone 250. Cash capex 3800 in 2026 then 3000 baseline pluspartnering.
items.uncertainty: Maintenance versus expansion split and June finance lease liability are not fully verified. Asset depreciation schedules not modeled by vintage.

items.basis: Base cash tax 22%2026 rises 23%; avoids extrapolating one-off discrete benefits. Operating NWC investment 3% of incremental gross-before-relief corporate revenue; H2 half-year charge estimated separately.
items.uncertainty: No claim that normalized tax equals period cash taxes; no cash-tax refunds or offshore tax-asset benefit added. Seasonal working-capital changes not forecast in detail.

items.basis: SBC remains in SGA as cash-replacement expense; no SBC addback or free future share shrinkage. June exact common shares 707641531 differ from H1 diluted EPS weighted shares 712.3 m. Existing awards are separately datedDecember 2025 and incomplete atJune.
items.editable: Only optional explicit capital allocation policy
items.uncertainty: Unknown existing-award reserve defaultsnull; no forced price allocation or option value from EPS dilution.

items.basis: Bear/base/bull WACC9.5/8/7%, g 2/2.5/3%, incremental ROIC13/18/22% are analyst scenario choices, not current observed market estimates. No beta, risk-free rate, ERP or market price is falsely described as verified.
items.uncertainty: g/ROIC reinvestment includes cash and economically financed assets; terminal D&A/capex/NWC are not deducted again. Substantial terminal dependence is exported. Economic ROIC is an assumption, not book ROE from negative equity.
